description: This file defines a final class `MetricsBuilder` that is responsible for gathering, encoding, and managing metrics related to AWS SDK requests. It includes constants for different metric types, methods to append various types of metrics, encode metrics to a string, and integrate metrics capturing middleware into a handler stack.

classes.name: MetricsBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for constructing and managing metrics related to AWS SDK requests, including appending various types of metrics, encoding them into a string, and integrating with command middleware.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MetricsBuilder instance with an empty metrics array and size counter.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Encodes the collected metrics into a comma-separated string for reporting.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the metrics array into a comma-separated string of metric keys.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new metric to the metrics collection if it does not exceed size constraints and is not duplicate.

methods.name: identifyMetricByValueAndAppend
methods.description: Identifies and appends a metric based on feature group and its value, such as signature type or compression format.

methods.name: appendSignatureMetric
methods.description: Appends a signature-type metric based on the provided signature string.

methods.name: appendRequestCompressionMetric
methods.description: Appends a compression-related metric based on the format.

methods.name: appendRequestChecksumMetric
methods.description: Appends checksum algorithm metrics based on the provided algorithm name.

methods.name: appendCredentialsMetric
methods.description: Determines the credentials source and appends the corresponding metric.

methods.name: canMetricBeAppended
methods.description: Validates if a new metric can be added without exceeding size limits and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: fromCommand
methods.description: Retrieves a MetricsBuilder instance associated with a command.

methods.name: appendMetricsCaptureMiddleware
methods.description: Adds middleware to a handler list to capture and append metrics during request processing.
